t: What is the difference between “buy” and “bought”? - Quora
s: Answer (1 of 7): “Buy” is the present indefinite tense of the verb while “bought” is the past tense of the verb. For example: I buy oranges. (that it is a habit) I will buy oranges.

t: bought vs. brought | Dictionary.com
s: Bought is the past tense and past participle of buy. Brought is the past tense and past participle of bring. In very specific situations—such as presenting a purchased gift to someone—it can appear that the two words mean the same thing.
